title: Mapping between access categories/access identities and RRC establishment cause

entities.name: NAS signalling connection establishment
entities.description: Procedure where 5GMM requests establishment of a NAS-signalling connection, requiring selection of RRC establishment cause based on access identities and access categories.

entities.name: Access identity
entities.description: Identifies UE priority categories (e.g., 1 for MPS, 2 for MCS, 0 for MT access, 11-15 for high priority).

entities.name: Access category
entities.description: Categorizes access attempts (e.g., 0 for MT access, 1 for delay tolerant, 2 for emergency, 3-7 for MO services, 9 for IMS registration, 10 for exception data).

entities.name: RRC establishment cause
entities.description: Determines the cause for RRC connection establishment (e.g., mps-PriorityAccess, mcs-PriorityAccess, highPriorityAccess, mt-Access, emergency, mo-Signalling, mo-VoiceCall, mo-VideoCall, mo-SMS, mo-Data, mo-ExceptionData).

entities.name: Rule selection condition
entities.description: Condition where RRC establishment cause is selected based on the lowest rule number when multiple rules match the access attempt.

entities.name: Operator-defined access category condition
entities.description: Condition where if the determined access category is operator-defined, RRC establishment cause is selected based on the standardized access category mapped for the operator-defined category.

entities.name: RRC release with redirection condition
entities.description: Condition following RRC release with redirection where lower layers can set RRC establishment cause to mpsPriorityAccess (NR cell) or highPriorityAccess (EUTRA cell) if the UE has an active MPS session.

entities.name: Lowest rule number used
entities.description: Property that if the access attempt matches more than one rule, the RRC establishment cause of the lowest rule number shall be used.

relations.description: NAS signalling connection establishment procedure includes selecting the RRC establishment cause.
RRC establishment cause selection is guarded by access identities.
RRC establishment cause selection is guarded by access categories.
Condition where multiple rules match establishes the property that the lowest rule number is used.
Operator-defined access category condition guards the selection of RRC establishment cause based on standardized mapping.
RRC release with redirection condition guards the setting of RRC establishment cause to specific values for MPS sessions.
